newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Employment Dept jobs indicator rises.
newsitem.headline: Australian Employment Dept jobs indicator rises.

text.p: The Australian government's leading indicator of employment rose to minus 0.459 in March from minus 0.491 in February, the Employment Department said on Wednesday.
Earlier figures had been revised by the Department of Employment, Education Training and Youth Affairs (DEETYA), as usual.
"The current revision of the DEETYA Leading Indicator suggests an increase in the rate of employment growth in coming months," the department said in a statement.
The indicator is an amalgam of seven statistical series, including vehicle registratoins, housing approvals and job vacancies.
Since the early 1980s, it has consistently anticipated turns in the labour market -- beginning to rise or fall before employment does -- but with highly variable lags.
